resources.string:
Setup Instructions:

1. On the ScreenMate Receiver device, install MacroDroid and create a new Macro.

2. Add a Trigger: \"Connectivity\" -> \"Web Hook (HTTP)\". Choose an ID (e.g. \"nav\").

3. MacroDroid will provide a URL. Copy it and paste it in the field below.

4. Add a Variable to the Macro: name it \"value\" (type String).

5. Add an Action: \"Device Actions\" -> \"Send Intent\".

6. Configure Intent: Action: android.intent.action.VIEW, Data: {lv=value}, Target: Activity.

Pairing Steps:

1. On the Receiver device, tap \"Generate Topic and Key\" (if you already did, tap \"Show QR code for the Sender\").

2. On this phone, tap \"Scan Receiver QR\" above and point the camera at the QR code on the Receiver.

3. Done: in Google Maps tap Share on a place or a route and choose SendTo ScreenMate.
Set a valid topic in Settings (letters, numbers, - and _) or scan the Receiver QR code
Encryption is on but no key is set: scan the Receiver QR code
Text is too long: shorten it and try again
Note: Any text entered here will be processed for locations/links before sending.
